name: Disable Core Parking
description: Sets CPMINCORES to 100% on the active power scheme so Windows never parks a core mid-benchmark.

name: Disable CPU Idle States
description: Sets IDLEDISABLE on the active power scheme, preventing C-state transitions during measurement.

name: Power Plan
description: Switches the active Windows power plan for this scenario. The target plan is chosen from the plans installed on your system when this tweak is added.

name: P-Core Only Affinity
description: Pins cs2.exe to performance cores only (hybrid Intel CPUs), excluding E-cores.

name: Exclude Core 0
description: Excludes physical core 0 (and its SMT sibling) from cs2.exe's affinity mask.

name: Launch Options
description: Edits CS2's launch options for this scenario. Pre-filled with your current launch options when added -- VOIDFRAME only ever adds its own required options on top, it never overwrites what you set.

name: Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
description: Turns Windows' hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling on (HwSchMode = 2). Requires a reboot to take effect; the scenario reboots automatically and VOIDFRAME resumes after logon. Toggle it off by setting 1.

name: Windows Game Mode
description: Turns Windows' Game Mode on (AutoGameModeEnabled = 1). Takes effect immediately, no reboot needed. Toggle it off by setting 0.

name: Win32PrioritySeparation
description: Sets the thread-scheduling quantum/interval/foreground-boost combination Windows uses (Win32PrioritySeparation). Applies immediately -- no reboot needed, same as changing it from sysdm.cpl. Pick the value that isn't already your machine's current one.

name: CS2 Video Config
description: Edits CS2's video settings (cs2_video.txt) for this scenario -- shadow/texture/particle quality, MSAA, FSR, HDR, and more. The pristine file is snapshotted and restored on revert.

name: Custom Script
description: Runs your own apply/revert .bat/.cmd/.ps1 scripts for this scenario. VOIDFRAME hashes and runs your revert script but cannot verify what it actually did -- results from a scenario using this are marked 'script-reverted, unverified'.
